text: Bitcoin's modest 1.3% gain is outpacing Ethereum's 0.9% rise, pushing BTC dominance to 56.4%, suggesting investors are rotating toward the largest asset during cautious conditions. The Fear & Greed index at 28 reflects genuine wariness despite the uptick, with sentiment deteriorating over the past week, indicating this price movement lacks conviction. Volume at $51B is moderate, consistent with a consolidation phase where traders are waiting for clearer directional signals rather than committing heavily to either side.
